$comment: Brand files pinned by sha256 as they ship today (MUT-401 eng D5, D9): the mark, the nine web icons and the MTB3A logotype. wordmark.test.ts checks every file matches its pin. A changed hash means a file was replaced or overwritten: re-pin only in the commit that deliberately replaces it. Only the logotype follows the never-edit rule (a bad export is re-exported from Claude Design, eng D4). public/favicon.svg is not a Claude Design export: MUT-104 fixed it by hand because the delivered and re-exported tiles fell back to black, so never replace it with a fresh export.
